messages:
Maya (CSM): quick sync — SafeHarbor preview cohort seat counts changed to 12 (from 15). IT delayed SSO. we need a plan for enablement and feedback cadence.
Liam (Onboard): noted. do we have target enablement date from IT?
Alex (Customer PM): they said tentatively 'end of next week' but it's not committed. risk: they may push renewal conditions if SSO not in by pilot close.
Maya (CSM): agreed — renewal sentiment is neutral until SSO. want to propose 2 tracks: (A) proceed with 12 invited seats with manual login + scheduled enablement; (B) hold invites until SSO. thoughts? :thinking_face:
Priya (SE): for track A i can drop a short SSO onboarding doc and a one-hour enablement session. track B wastes early usage data.
Eden (Success Manager): +1 for A. we still collect feedback and session notes, but flag the account as SSO-risk in CRM. i can add renewal note. :warning:
Alex (Customer PM): ok go A but mark messaging clearly that SSO is coming and export of data will be supported post-SSO.
Maya (CSM): cool. Liam — can you run invites for 12 and schedule enablement? also we need a lightweight feedback survey after week 1 and week 3.
Liam (Onboard): will do. sending invites today. proposed enablement slots: Tue 10am or Thu 3pm. which should i pick?
Priya (SE): Thu 3pm works for me.
Maya (CSM): Thu 3pm then. Liam please create a calendar invite and post meeting link here.
OnboardBot: User group 'safeharbor-preview' created and 12 invites queued.
Liam (Onboard): calendar invite posted: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/xx12345 — added agenda and Zoom link.
Maya (CSM): survey draft for feedback — please review quick. keep it 4 questions max.
Priya (SE): love short. draft below. agree/disagree scale.
```
1) How easy was onboarding? (1-5)
2) Did the model outputs meet expectations? (1-5)
3) Any blockers (SSO, data, infra)? (free text)
4) Would you recommend Redwood to a colleague? (yes/no)
```
Maya (CSM): tidy. please add one field to capture "primary use case" (dropdown) before sending.
Eden (Success Manager): i'll tag the survey responses in CRM and set a follow-up task for accounts scoring <=3.
Alex (Customer PM): also capture any latency/cost complaints — we want to correlate to token usage.
Liam (Onboard): survey link will be in invite and sent at day 7 + day 21. posting link here when live.
Maya (CSM): owner list: Liam = invites & calendar, Priya = enablement session, Eden = CRM tagging & renewal flag, Alex = customer comms. i'll own survey and follow ups.
Priya (SE): will prepare a 30-min demo + 15-min Q&A. sharing slides by EOD tomorrow.
Maya (CSM): last note — mark this customer as "pilot: high-touch" and set renewal risk = medium until SSO confirmed.
Alex (Customer PM): agreed. i'll mention the risk in weekly product sync so infra prioritization can be considered.
Maya (CSM): perfect. thanks everyone :thumbsup: — closing thread, will post invite & survey links once live.
Liam (Onboard): invite sent, survey draft posted: https://forms.redwood.ai/r/safeharbor-week1
Maya (CSM): received. leaving a follow-up in two weeks.
Eden (Success Manager): logging renewal note in CRM now.
Priya (SE): slides uploaded to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/safeharbor/onboard-slides
Maya (CSM): thanks — end of thread.
